Portland, Oregon }} '''Terrence Jones''' (born January 9, 1992 in [[Portland, Oregon]]) is an [[United States|American]] [[college basketball]] player for the [[University of Kentucky]]. He was one of the top rated basketball players in the class of 2010. ==High school career== He was the #8 player in the class of 2010 by [[Scout.com]],{{cite web|url=http://scouthoops.scout.com/a.z?s=75&p=9&c=4&pid=88&yr=2010 |title=Scout.com: Football Recruiting |publisher=Scouthoops.scout.com |date= |accessdate=2010-08-26}} #9 player in the [[ESPNU]] 100,{{cite web|url=http://insider.espn.go.com/ncb/recruiting/tracker/espnu100?&season=2010&action=upsell&appRedirect=http%3a%2f%2finsider.espn.go.com%2fncb%2frecruiting%2ftracker%2fespnu100%3f%26season%3d2010 |title=College Basketball Recruiting - ESPNU 100 - ESPN |publisher=Insider.espn.go.com |date= |accessdate=2010-08-26}} and rated as the #13 player by [[Rivals.com]].{{cite web|url=http://rivalshoops.rivals.com/viewrank.asp?ra_key=1909 |title=Yahoo Sports: Rivals.com Ranking - Rivals150 for class of 2010 |publisher=Rivalshoops.rivals.com |date= |accessdate=2010-08-26}} Jones led [[Jefferson High School (Portland, Oregon)|Jefferson High School]] to three straight Oregon class 5A state championships between his sophomore and senior years.{{cite web|url=http://www.kgw.com/sports/Jefferson-three-peats-with-win-over-Mountain-View-87617022.html |title=Jefferson three-peats with win over Mountain View | kgw.com | Portland News, Local News, Breaking News, Weather | Sports |publisher=kgw.com |date=2010-03-14 |accessdate=2010-08-26}} On January 20, 2010, it was announced that Jones was selected to the 2010 Junior National Select Team. The team played at the 2010 [[Nike Hoop Summit]] at the [[Rose Garden (arena)|Rose Garden]] in [[Portland, Oregon]] on April 10.{{cite web|last=Name |first=Author |url=http://www.slamonline.com/online/college-hs/high-school/2010/01/its-the-usa-against-everyone-else/ |title=It’s the USA Against Everyone Else |publisher=Slam Online |date=2010-01-20 |accessdate=2010-08-26}} He was also selected to play in the [[2010 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2010 McDonald's All-American Game]]{{cite web|author= |url=http://www.kptv.com/sports/22543606/detail.html |title=Jefferson's Terrence Jones Named All-American - Sports News Story - KPTV Portland |publisher=Kptv.com |date=2010-02-12 |accessdate=2010-08-26}} and the 2010 Jordan Brand Classic.{{cite web|url=http://www.nike.com/jumpman23/classic/2010jbc.html |title=Jordan Brand Classic |publisher=Nike.com |date=2010-02-18 |accessdate=2010-08-26}} ==College career== Jones committed to [[Washington Huskies men's basketball|Washington]] on April 30, 2010,{{cite news|last=Allen |first=Percy |url=http://seattletimes.nwsource.com/html/huskies/2011749015_umen01.html |title=Huskies | Terrence Ross signs with Huskies; commits but doesn't sign | Seattle Times Newspaper |publisher=Seattletimes.nwsource.com |date= 2010-04-30|accessdate=2010-08-26}} but didn't sign a [[National Letter of Intent|letter of intent]]. He ended up changing his mind and on May 19, 2010, he signed a financial aid agreement{{cite web|author=Nick Daschel, Special to The Oregonian |url=http://highschoolsports.oregonlive.com/news/article/5440206792650152273/terrence-jones-signs-agreement-with-kentucky/ |title=Terrence Jones signs agreement with Kentucky - OregonLive.com |publisher=Highschoolsports.oregonlive.com |date=2010-05-19 |accessdate=2010-08-26}} with [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]] instead of a letter of intent.{{cite web|last=Leung |first=Diamond |url=http://espn.go.com/blog/collegebasketballnation/post/_/id/11635/report-terrence-jones-signs-with-kentucky |title=Report: Terrence Jones signs with Kentucky - College Basketball Nation Blog - ESPN |publisher=ESPN |date= |accessdate=2010-08-26}} Jones had 25 points and 12 rebounds in his University of Kentucky debut in a win vs. East Tennessee State. Along with Doron Lamb, the two became the first freshman duo in UK history to score 20 points in a debut.{{cite web|url=http://espn.go.com/ncb/recap?gameId=303160096 |title=Kentucky wakes up in second half, finishes off ETSU |publisher=Espn.go.com |date=2010-11-12 |accessdate=2011-11-15}} On January 11, 2011, Jones came off the bench for the first time in his UK career after not being able to participate in that day's practice due to illness. That night, he broke the UK freshman single-game scoring record, putting up 35 points on 11 of 17 shooting against Auburn University. This came just one month after teammate Doron Lamb set the record with 32 points.{{cite web|url=http://stats.washingtonpost.com/cbk/recap.asp?g=201101110292&home=292&vis=28&final=true |title=Basketball | NCAA | Game Recap - Auburn v Kentucky - washingtonpost.com |publisher=Stats.washingtonpost.com |date=2011-01-11 |accessdate=2011-11-15}} Entering his sophomore year and becoming a member of the [[2011–12 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team]], Jones would be part of what is considered "the most highly anticipated" Kentucky basketball teams of all time based on pre-season hype, recruit expectations, and existing talent.{{cite web|url=http://www.nationofblue.com/terrence-jones-spurns-cash-stays-kentucky-7109/ |title=Terrence Jones Spurns the Cash, Stays at Kentucky |publisher=Nationofblue.com |date= |accessdate=2011-11-15}} On October 26, 2011 Terrence Jones participated in Kentucky's annual Blue vs. White scrimmage, scoring a school-record 52 points.{{cite web|last=Fields |first=Mike |url=http://www.kentucky.com/2011/10/27/1935986/live-uk-basketball-blue-white.html |title=Terrence Jones scores 52, freshmen shine in Kentucky basketball Blue-White Scrimmage | University of Kentucky Sports News | Lexington Herald-Leader |publisher=Kentucky.com |date= |accessdate=2011-11-15}} As of December 9, 2011, Terrence Jones is averaging 15.0 PPG, 7.5 RPG, 1.8 APG for the season. He was the "Preseason Player of the Year" of the SEC and will likely be a 1st Team Sec selection. ==Professional career== Jones announced that he would enter the [[2011 NBA Draft]] where he was expected to be a first round selection, though he had not signed with an agent, leaving him the option to return to Kentucky by withdrawing his name from the draft by May 8.{{cite news |title=Brandon Knight entering NBA draft |url=http://sports.espn.go.com/nba/draft2011/news/story?id=6395107&campaign=rss&source=ESPNUHeadlines|work=ESPN.com |date=April 20, 2011}} In April 2012, Terrence declared for the [[2012 NBA Draft]].{{citeweb|url=http://espn.go.com/nba/draft2012/story/_/id/7825727/kentucky-wildcats-starting-five-declares-nba-draft|title=UK's starting five opts for draft|date= 18 April 2012|work=ESPN|accessdate=30 May 2012 }} ==Personal== Jones's cousins include former NBA players [[Damon Stoudamire]] and [[Salim Stoudamire]].{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncaa/recruiting/basketball/mens/news/story?id=4525076 |title=Basketball is in Jones' DNA |publisher=Sports.espn.go.com |date=2009-10-02 |accessdate=2011-11-15}}
